svg.title: Its token insertions IN,p,v,x are continuous, gauge invariant and local on a fixed finite offset stencil for each token v, uniformly in N, p, x. A finite set of integer offsets depending only on v con- trols each insertion at every N, p, x: agreement of configurations on edges whose endpoints belong to the translated offset set implies equality of the insertions. Its positive coupling slope obeys βN,p/ log(h−1 N ) →s > 0 uniformly in p. For every strictly increasing period index sequence p(k) there is a strictly increasing refinement q(k) and a single hierarchy on p(q(k)). Its graded finite-dimensional complex normed spaces Fd inject into, and jointly cover, the field-label space of one Wightman theory; tokens project onto their disjoint union. A compact metric character space carries a full-support Borel probability measure and a selected character. The separated correlations Sχ n and unselected Sn are smooth away from R Sχ collisions, permutation invariant, continuous in the character and satisfy Sn = ndμ(χ).
